主题：CapEx Approval Policy 2026
Capital expenditure approval levels:

- Under $10,000: Department head approval sufficient (check Approvals column)
- $10,000 - $50,000: Department head + VP Finance required
- Over $50,000: Full executive committee (dept head + VP + CEO)
- IT equipment: always requires IT Director sign-off regardless of amount
- Requests without a business case attached: leave unchanged and do not notify
- CapEx budget remaining must cover the request (check Budget Remaining)

- CFO"}
